horoscope: You can crave happy company today, dear Aries, but you may be swinging from a generous mood to a more serious frame of mind. Jupiter has been encouraging you to take a risk with your heart or with your creativity these days, but the Sun is stirring a desire for deeper bonds and connections, and this mini struggle can come to a head now. Watch that you don't take risks that are over the top, particularly with money, as instincts for financial matters may be out of step just for now. Uncertainty about how to proceed in a relationship or about someone's feelings for you can be an issue. While you might wait on important moves, it's a fine time to dream up plans and ideas.

The Sun is currently energizing your partnership sector, dear Taurus, and it's clashing with Jupiter, which is encouraging your focus on home and family, and the North Node, which wants you to prioritize your broader goals. As a result, demands can come from all sides, and you may feel overwhelmed. However, this is also a great time to dream up creative ways to approach your life and enjoy all the new developments. Any discontent you've been harboring recently can emerge today. There can be so many things you want to do, but it's hard to put them into action. The key is to start smaller and work yourself up.

You may be taking stock of what you've accomplished and considering whether you've done or achieved enough these days, dear Gemini. You may feel moody if your personal "report card" isn't up to par. You can have much difficulty concentrating and focusing today, and overlooking important details can get you into a little trouble. Try not to move forward on a new idea right now, at least not too quickly, and avoid taking on too much in an effort to catch up or get somewhere fast. Spreading yourself out too thin will not lead to success.

Today's energies are optimistic, dear Cancer, but it's all too easy to go a little too far with expectations. Whether it's about wanting to impress someone you love or just because you're in a good mood and want to share today, the tendency is to go over the top. If you're investing in the wrong things, moodiness can ensue. Ups and downs are possible, but it's also a great time for seeing where you've been pushing too hard. Jupiter encourages you to enjoy comforts while the Sun wants you to move out of your comfort zone to find new pleasures and channels for expression. Respecting your limits and avoiding promises and inflated expectations can help tremendously now. You can have a good time today, but it's best to know your limits.

Restlessness may be stirring today, dear Leo, and you may need to monitor it since you or someone around you could be blowing an observation or matter out of proportion, leading to unnecessary stress. Optimism can trip you up right now if it closes your eyes to practical elements. Your confidence radiates, and it could attract good things, as long as you control the tendency to go over the top. You might feel torn between nurturing your strong need for security and safety and your equally strong desire for personal space and autonomy. While you can imagine all sorts of things you'd like to accomplish, part of you is holding back, or the demands of home and family are keeping you feeling tied down. Consider ways to manage your expectations, strike a compromise, and find a better balance.

You are called to take a look at the larger picture in life and to assess whether recent projects are headed in the right direction, dear Virgo. However, overoptimism can leave us vulnerable to self-deception today, as the Sun heads toward a square with Jupiter. You may be seeking more meaning in your work or your efforts to help others. Watch for faulty judgment today, as you may not be seeing all the facts. Try not to take on too much, particularly when it comes to serving and helping others, which you have been doing more than enough of recently. It's a question of time and energy, as you need to take better care of yourself.

A friend can promise a little too much more than they can reasonably deliver today, dear Libra, and the same may be true of an idea. Instead, a project or plan can now show signs of weakness. While this can rain on your parade, you can also choose to work on problem areas and improve rather than give up on something that's important to you. There is a general feeling that we can do more than we actually can today, and while there are generally good intentions involved, it's better not to bank on promises made now. You may want to wait until you see things more clearly before making a big purchase.

Today's Sun-Jupiter square has a way of revealing areas where you may have been overdoing things, dear Scorpio. The Sun in your sign has been encouraging you to focus on personal growth and efforts toward self-improvement, while Jupiter is pushing performance, ambition, and career or accomplishment. You want to do both well, but something has to give. Allow yourself to dream and think big, but try not to overdo things, as you'll end up too exhausted when true opportunities present themselves. It's best to aim to make changes that get your expectations down to earth before going forward.

Part of you feels restless and hungry for something different, dear Sagittarius, but you may not have a plan or clear direction right now. You could also be tied to obligations or service to others. Guilt could be holding you back from doing your own thing. You might also be second-guessing yourself, but you could also be struggling to feel satisfied with the status quo. It's important to be extra sensitive when it comes to exchanging opinions today, as a debate can become a whole lot more intense. Be discreet today. You may not have all the information necessary to solve a problem, so it may be wise to wait it out.

With current Sun aspects, dear Capricorn, there can be a tendency to go overboard, either with actions, statements, promises, or expectations. Keeping these things in check can make all the difference now. People tend to exaggerate or blow things out of proportion today, so consider reserving judgment for now. Avoid overcommitting, which can be the go-to tendency as a means to put something out of your way. Dissatisfaction with routines or simply your current state of affairs can be more prominent now. Adjustments need to be made. In fact, a waning in enthusiasm is natural and temporary at this point. While thinking in big terms is fine, today's energies point to a tendency to be immoderate, or to overshoot.

With current Sun transits, dear Aquarius, desires can be difficult to fulfill today. Do your best not to skip steps because you're anxious to get the ball rolling. Pushing too hard towards a goal can wear you down or overwhelm you, which is counterproductive. Aim to pace yourself. Opening your mind to new possibilities and ideas is entirely worthwhile now, however. Instincts tell you one thing, and people tell you another today, making it difficult to arrive at clear decisions. Keep things as real as possible, and while you should listen to others' points of view, don't be swayed by promises made now, as they may be hard to keep. Watch for errors made from ignoring or glossing over details.

The Moon moves into your sign today, dear Pisces, and your emotions are at the forefront. You tend to lead by your feelings today. As the day advances, however, there can be some pressure or a sense that you don't have the time or energy to accomplish your larger goals. Avoid skipping important steps to reach an ambition, and consider pacing yourself instead. Becoming overwhelmed by things to do will not help you achieve more, and right now, the desire for some freedom from restrictions and routines is strong. Avoid taking on more tasks, as they will only add to your pile of worries. You can have fabulous business ideas now, but they may not yet hold a lot of weight. Don't discard them! Instead, take note and aim to fill in the details later. Restlessness can lead to mistakes today if you're stuck in a routine.
